turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to grow potatoes but I've only got a patio. Is that daft?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not daft at all. Potatoes grow well in big bags or tubs, and tipping them out at harvest is honestly the best bit.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Something around the size of a laundry basket, with drainage holes. Three seed potatoes per bag is plenty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just finished a really long fantasy series and now I feel kind of lost.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That book hangover is real. Do you want another big series to sink into, or something short and different as a palate cleanser?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang tight, my dad is calling me over. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, have you seen the new one with the space station?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, last weekend. It was okay. The ending was a bit weird.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I won't. Let's just say you'll have questions.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, now I have to watch it. Would you see it again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe, if you're buying the popcorn.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were finding your next read. Big series or something short?
